title: A Morning at the Bakery
text:
Anna works at a small bakery in Lviv. Yesterday, a journalist asked her about her job. Anna said she starts work at five in the morning. She makes bread, cakes, and cookies for the customers.

The journalist asked Anna what she loves about her job. Anna smiled and said she loves the smell of fresh bread. She also enjoys meeting the customers every morning. In the afternoon, she goes home and rests, because the day is long.

questions.text: What time does Anna start work?
What does Anna say she loves?
Why does Anna probably rest in the afternoon?
options: She feels tired after an early start
She does not like her job

questions.text: What can we infer about the journalist?
options: They are interested in Anna's daily work
They want to buy the bakery

people who buy things from a shop
a person who writes news stories for newspapers or television
new and not old or stale

paragraph_translations: Анна працює в невеликій пекарні у Львові. Вчора журналіст запитав її про роботу. Анна сказала, що починає роботу о п'ятій ранку. Вона готує хліб, торти та печиво для клієнтів.

Журналіст запитав Анну, що їй подобається в її роботі. Анна посміхнулася і сказала, що любить запах свіжого хліба. Вона також любить щоранку спілкуватися з клієнтами. Вдень вона йде додому і відпочиває, бо день довгий.
